Parameter table of one NONMEM run, exported to Word

Source: R/nm_extract_run_table.R
nm_extract_run_table.Rd

Reads the .ext file of a run and writes a Word document with the parameter estimates, 95% confidence intervals and RSE. When there is no .ext file, or when it holds no estimates (empty file), the estimates printed in the .lst file are used, as in nm_extract_runs(); the table footer then says so. ETA and EPS standard deviations are derived from the variances (delta method for their SE); ETA correlations are derived from the OMEGA matrix.

Usage

nm_extract_run_table(
  run = NULL,
  run_name = NULL,
  run_path = NULL,
  output_name = "nonmem_results.docx",
  extensions = c("nm7", "reg"),
  ...
)

Arguments

run

Path of the run: run directory, control stream or stem.

run_name

Deprecated: with run_name, run is read as the parent directory (former argument run_rep) and run_name as the run name. A full path given here by mistake is converted automatically.

run_path

Deprecated: former name of run.

output_name

Name of the Word file, written in the run directory (default "nonmem_results.docx").

extensions

Run directory extensions to try first, in order (default c("nm7", "reg")), before the folder <run> and the flat layout.

...

Former argument name, accepted with a warning until version 1.0: run_rep (with run_name).

Value

Invisibly, an object of class nm_run_table (a list, printed as a short summary) with flextable, params (parameter table), ext (parsed .ext, or estimates read in the .lst, with source = "lst"), output_file, ext_file (NA without .ext), lst_file, run_dir and extension.

Details

The run is given by its path, run: its run directory (.nm7, .reg), its control stream, or its stem (e.g. C:/project/run1 for C:/project/run1.ext). The .ext file is looked for in <run>.nm7/, <run>.reg/, a folder named <run>, then directly in the folder of the run (flat layout, as produced by a plain nmfe call). Wings for NONMEM is not required.

The former call forms, run_rep (parent directory) + run_name, and run_path, are still accepted with a warning until version 1.0.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
res <- nm_extract_run_table("C:/nm76g64/run/para/run_1_prop_kaBbloc.reg")
res <- nm_extract_run_table("C:/nm76g64/run/para/run_1_prop_kaBbloc.ctl")
res$params
} # }
